title: Ab initio study of Curie temperatures of diluted III-V magnetic semiconductors
abstract: The electronic structure of diluted (Ga,Mn)As magnetic semiconductors in the presence of As-antisites and magnetic disorder is studied within the framework of the local spin density approximation. Both the chemical and magnetic disorders are treated using the coherent potential approximation. A ground state with partial disorder in the local moments and with a reduced total magnetic moment appears in the presence of As-antisites. We first estimate the Curie temperature T_c from total energy differences between the ferromagnetic and the paramagnetic state by identifying these with the corresponding energy difference in a classical Heisenberg model. A more systematic approach within the framework of the mean-field approximation to estimate T_c consists in an evaluation of the effective exchange fields acting on the magnetic moment at a given site. The presence of As-antisites strongly reduces the Curie temperature. The results indicate that the effect of impurities on the electronic structure cannot be neglected and influences the Curie temperature non-negligibly. A comparison of the calculated Curie temperatures to existing experimental data indicates an increase of the donor concentration with the increase of the Mn-content.
